convos.name: Cheyenne
lines: YOU: "What did you see out there?"
NPC: "Nightlight — A soft green glow under the water. It hunts at night — give the dark a wide berth."
NPC: You walk to the trap line with Cheyenne. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
NPC: "Since Daniela died... I keep expecting to see Daniela at the fire. Stupid."
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "Rest and clean water aren't cutting it. If this turns, I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. I need someone who knows what they're doing."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I keep turning over the last thing Daniela said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
NPC: Their voice loosens. The guardedness thins.
NPC: "Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
NPC: Nods slowly. "Columbus, Ohio. I'll remember that. Everybody's from somewhere that isn't here."
NPC: "Okay so — Funny — I keep a little map in my head of where everyone says they're from. Like we might go back and check."
NPC: "I should go before I say something sincere."

convos.name: Tanya
lines: YOU: "Patience. Sounds dumb. But waiting — really waiting, without fidgeting — that's a superpower now."
NPC: "Not dumb at all. The people who can't wait are the ones who make mistakes. You're an asset."
YOU: "What's weighing on you right now?"
NPC: "You want to know about that? Okay." "Daniela is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "About that question — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
YOU: "You don't have to say it all at once."
NPC: A neutral quiet returns, the kind where words land normally.
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "Sleep's gone strange. I tend the fire without being asked at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
NPC: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
NPC: Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
NPC: "What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
YOU: "That it's intentional. That someone's watching and this is all... on purpose."
NPC: They go quiet. "Yeah. Me too. The randomness would almost be kinder."
NPC: "Okay. We'll pick this up later."

convos.name: Omar
lines: NPC: "I think the asking matters more than the answer, out here."
NPC: "Do the math with me: 9 liters, 10 people. That's not tomorrow's water. The creek's a twenty-minute walk — with two of us it's one trip, not three."
NPC: "Daniela is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I do push-ups at dawn. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
NPC: "We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
NPC: "I do push-ups at dawn for Daniela, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
NPC: "I should go. You know where to find me."

convos.name: Sigrun
lines: NPC: «Stemmer.» — Mia translates: "That's right." They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «Ja, ja, akkurat.» — Mia translates: "Yes, yes, exactly." They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «Ja, du har rett.» — Mia translates: "Yes, you're right." They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «Akkurat sånn. Helt riktig.» — Mia translates: "Exactly like that. Completely right." They nod back, slowly. "Hello?"
NPC: Their gestures slow — the conversation thinning like light at dusk.

notes: staged gut-rot outbreak on 5 adults at d16; downstream (ticks/tending/relief/convo) fully real
